title: Retail Energy Supplier
summary: Capabilities of a domestic and SME electricity and gas supplier: acquisition, switching, metering data, billing, debt, trading and settlement, and industry compliance.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for a UK retail energy supplier, drafted for the Atlas demo organisation. Vocabulary drawn from public Ofgem licence conditions, the Balancing and Settlement Code, MHHS programme and SMETS2 / DCC documentation (consulted, not copied). Draft only — not yet reviewed by a domain expert.

sources.citation: Ofgem supply licence conditions, BSC/MHHS programme and DCC documentation (consulted for vocabulary; not copied)

items.name: Revenue Assurance

items.name: Customer Service & Contact

items.name: Debt Management & Collections

items.name: Energy Trading & Settlement

items.name: Smart Energy & Net Zero

valueStreams.name: Acquire & Onboard
valueStreams.description: Starts when a prospect enquires or switches. Ends when they are registered, welcomed and have a smart meter booked.

valueStreams.name: Meter to Cash
valueStreams.description: Starts when meter data is collected. Ends when the bill is issued and payment is collected.

valueStreams.name: Care & Support
valueStreams.description: Starts when a customer contacts us. Ends when the issue is resolved and vulnerable customers are protected.

valueStreams.name: Trade & Settle
valueStreams.description: Starts when demand is forecast. Ends when the energy is bought and settled with the industry.
